## Change and purpose

Explain the improvement to the example or its documentation.

## Expected results and validation

State the expected behavior-test and contract outcomes, and describe how you checked them. A DRIFT demonstration must keep its failing contract check visible.

## Demo preservation

Keep PRs #1 and #2 open as teaching examples. Do not merge their implementation branches or change the baseline just to make the drifting check green. Do not replace pinned tool revisions or captured run identities without reproducing and documenting the new results.

Read NOTICE before contributing. Include only synthetic or sanitized data.
